verdict.rationale: No evidence describes a dedicated bulk-edit feature. What is documented are building blocks for scripting operations across many items: the REST and GraphQL APIs, GitHub CLI, and GitHub Actions automation. There is also org-wide security work, namely security campaigns paired with Copilot Autofix and secret remediation across an organization. missing for 10: explicit documented bulk actions on issues/PRs/repos (multi-select edit, batch API endpoints), AI-agent-driven multi-item operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
